summary.goal: Review plan and configuration before starting execution. Builds confidence and catches issues before agents are spawned.

acceptance_criteria.description: Plan summary: goal, step count, scope count, estimated duration
Pre-flight checklist with status: repos accessible, roles mapped, gates identified
Environment selector dropdown if multiple environments configured
Start Forging button (calls POST /runs/:id/start)
Cancel button returns to previous view
Validation errors block start with clear messages

observations: Pre-flight validates configuration before expensive operations
Environment selector maps to scope->repo configuration
Checklist items come from Forge validation endpoint
Cross-service API call to Planner requires special handling

cross_service_api.pattern: Forge UI calls both Forge API and Planner API
cross_service_api.vite_proxy_dev: Proxy /api to Planner backend in vite.config.ts for development
cross_service_api.production_cors: Configure CORS on Planner API to accept Forge UI origin, or use API gateway
cross_service_api.fallback: If Planner unavailable, show error: 'Cannot connect to Planner service. Please try again or contact support.'

steps.title: Create preflight API module
steps.description: API functions for preflight checks and run creation, including cross-service Planner API calls

acceptance_criteria.description: getPlanForPreflight(planId, version?) returns ForgePlan with summary and steps
validatePreflight(planId) returns { checks: PreflightCheck[], valid: boolean }
createRun(planId, options?: { environment?: string }) returns { run_id, status }
PreflightCheck type: { id, name, status: 'pass' | 'fail' | 'warning', message? }
PLANNER_API_BASE configurable via env var, default /api
Error handling for Planner unavailable: 'Cannot connect to Planner service'

cross_service.error_handling: Catch network errors specifically, return user-friendly message

specification.notes: Plan comes from Planner API, validation from Forge API

steps.title: Configure Vite proxy for Planner API
steps.description: Add Vite dev server proxy for Planner API calls

acceptance_criteria.description: vite.config.ts proxy /api to Planner backend (default localhost:3000)
Separate proxy target from /forge-api (which goes to Forge backend)
Document CORS requirements for production deployment

production_notes: Option 1: API Gateway that routes /api to Planner, /forge-api to Forge
Option 2: Configure CORS on Planner to accept Forge UI origin
Option 3: Forge backend proxies Planner requests (backend-to-backend)

acceptance_criteria.description: Plan goal as title

Plan version badge
Status icon: CheckIcon (pass), XIcon (fail), AlertTriangleIcon (warning)
Check name
Message shown for fail/warning status
Loading spinner while checking
Header: 'Pre-Flight Checks'
PreflightCheckItem for each check
Overall status: 'All checks passed' or 'N issues found'
Expand/collapse details for failed checks

default_checks: repos_accessible - All repositories can be cloned
dependencies_valid - Step dependencies form valid DAG

acceptance_criteria.description: Dropdown with available environments (development, staging, production)
Default to development
Warning badge for production
Hidden if only one environment available

design.production_warning: bg-error/20 text-error px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs

acceptance_criteria.description: Collapsible list of steps grouped by scope
Step title with gate indicator if applicable
Dependency lines between steps (simplified)
Default collapsed, expandable per scope

steps.title: Create usePreflight hook
steps.description: Data fetching for preflight page with cross-service error handling

acceptance_criteria.description: usePreflight(planId) returns { plan, checks, isLoading, error, revalidate, plannerAvailable }
Fetches plan from Planner API
Runs preflight validation
isValid computed from checks
plannerAvailable: false if Planner API unreachable, shows fallback UI

architecture.sequence: 1. Fetch plan from Planner, 2. Run validation in Forge, 3. Combine results

error_states.planner_unavailable: Show error card: 'Cannot connect to Planner service'
error_states.plan_not_found: Show error: 'Plan not found or not published'

Two-column: PreflightChecklist (left), StepsPreview (right)
